metadata.description: Fifteen security and quality controls that actually hold in your repository, and one command that proves which ones do.

plugins.name: control-register
plugins.description: Make your repository refuse commits carrying secrets, install dependencies frozen and get upgrade proposals for them, block on lint, types and tests at every locus, and protect its default branch — then verify all of it against what GitHub actually enforces. One command reports which controls hold and which cannot be checked.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: Choose a coding-standards profile for Python or React, see what each rule turns on and what it costs to satisfy before you say yes, and have it written into the configuration your linter already runs — with the half no linter can check handed back, labelled unenforced.

plugins.name: lint-md
plugins.description: Lint Markdown with one pinned markdownlint-cli2 while you write, before you commit and before you merge. Mirrored from the copy Equal Experts publishes in ee-skills, so a repository outside it can deploy DOC-001.

plugins.name: lint-yaml
plugins.description: Lint YAML with one pinned yamllint while you write, before you commit and before you merge, so a duplicate key fails rather than silently replacing a value. Mirrored from the copy Equal Experts publishes in ee-skills, so a repository outside it can deploy YML-001.
